# Pulled by .github/scripts/pull-models.sh. One `<backend> <model-id> [tier]`
# per line, backend `kronk` or `bucky`; blank lines and `#` comments ignored.
#
# tier is `base` when omitted: every runner pulls it, fork PRs included, so
# the base set stays at ~6.6 GiB — what an ubuntu-latest runner can hold.
# `gpu` is pulled only by gpu.yml's self-hosted legs, which have the disk and
# keep it between jobs. Anything a hosted runner could not hold goes there.
